messages:
Laura Chen: Heads-up: Marketplace listing for ACME HW needs final security artifacts by Friday EOD. Required: SOC2 report, redacted pen-test summary, supplier questionnaire, signed NDA, and partner-only bundle. Where are these?
Samir Patel: Ill fetch SOC2 + pen-test from vault and stage to a bucket. Need redaction rules from Security/Legal.
Rachel Gomez: Redaction rules (brief): remove private IPs, internal hostnames, full exploit PoCs, firmware model numbers from public bundle. Keep findings, mitigations, timelines.
Tom Nguyen: ACME insists on model numbers removed publicly and a partner-only bundle. Also requested an attestation about telemetry.
Laura Chen: Plan: 1) Samir uploads raw artifacts to staging with 48h TTL. 2) Rachel does redaction -> public + partner bundles, plus redaction_manifest.csv. 3) Legal approves attestation wording. 4) Tom does partner handoff and marketplace upload.
Samir Patel: Will upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-staging/acme-2126789012/ and create presigned links TTL=48h. Tag objects marketplace-evidence.
Maya (Compliance Bot): Reminder: presigned links to external parties require DLP review. Enable access_logging and add tag=marketplace-evidence. Retention default 90 days. See internal guide.
Rachel Gomez: Redaction checklist Im using:
```
- redact private IPs and hostnames
- strip raw PoC exploit code blocks
- remove firmware model numbers from public bundle
- replace emails with <redacted@company>
- produce redaction_manifest.csv
```
Will submit manifest to Legal for wording approval.
Tom Nguyen: ACME wants a signed statement we did not modify telemetry fields. Legal wants a draft.
Laura Chen: Ill draft the attestation. Rachel, include one-liner in manifest: "Redaction preserved telemetry schema; no telemetry values were altered."
Rachel Gomez: Added. Will include checksums for preserved telemetry files.
Samir Patel: Raw zip uploaded and presigned links posted to #private-ops. TTL 48h.
Maya (Compliance Bot): Auto-check: tag present, access_logging enabled. DLP review pending for external links.
Tom Nguyen: Scheduled handoff call tomorrow 10am PT. Invite includes ACME PM, Legal, Security, Eng.
Laura Chen: Owners: Samir = upload + presigns; Rachel = redact + manifest; Tom = partner handoff + upload; Laura = attestation draft + signoff. Flag blockers here.
Samir Patel: Working on it, will update here when Legal approves presigns. :thumbsup:
Rachel Gomez: Starting redaction after Samir confirms links. ETA Thu 12:00 PT.
Tom Nguyen: ACME confirmed call.
Laura Chen: Thanks team. If Legal asks for stricter redaction, Product Comms will update marketplace wording.
